insights.text: This test cannot yet name a winning creative. All four creatives together received 8,200 impressions, 66 clicks and 3 conversions, so a single extra click or conversion would reorder them. Creative C shows the most clicks and conversions, but at this volume that is as consistent with chance as with a real difference. We cannot yet tell whether any creative improves click-through or conversion; running the test until each creative has several thousand impressions and enough clicks to compare would show it, and budget should stay evenly split until then.
